commit.message:
feat(dashboard): connect all views to backend API and remove mock data

- Integrated live API endpoints across DashboardLayout and all tab views:
  * DashboardLayout: Live pulse, real KPI aggregation, live commit/finding streams, repo grid, and dynamic risk gauge
  * RepositoriesTab: Dynamic repo listing, commit stats, file counts, sizes, and language breakdown from GET /repo
  * CommitsTab: Real commit log from GET /repo/{id}/commits, repo selector, pagination, and AI review via /repo/commit/analysis
  * LiveFindingsTab: Live SecTest report telemetry from GET :8765/report.json with offline handling
  * AccountsTab: User directory from GET /tc-auth/account with pagination and deletion
  * SessionsTab: Active JWT sessions from GET /tc-auth/session with single and bulk revocation
  * SystemConfigTab: SMTP, JWT, GitHub, and Google OAuth config loading and updates
  * SecretDetectionTab & CicdDockerTab: Findings dynamically derived from commit analysis
- Expanded api.js with admin routes and removed hardcoded mock constants
- Added /repo proxy in vite.config.js
